g.text: Twenty unique development statements are evaluated in three configurations: 60 real local-model runs, with fixed inputs and separate fresh memory namespaces.
Validate gold quotations and PDF pages.
Statement + settings only go to verification.
Keep native traces, citations and usage.
expected label → scoring only (not model input)
Final measured benchmark | 60/60 correct and complete
Filter weak recall; deduplicate passages; stop stagnant searches.
28.2% fewer tokens; 11.5% fewer LLM calls; 17.5% faster.
Memory ON vs OFF: 4 fewer LLM calls and 4 fewer tool calls;
token savings 0.9%. These are local, single-run measurements.
92 automated tests; 12 / 12 additional live API cases.
Clean installation and GitHub CI passed. Swagger + UI verified.
Fresh namespaces; no answer cache or case-ID routing.
Preserve the original baseline alongside the final predictions.
Development benchmark, not held-out generalization evidence.
Reproduce: python -m filing_checker.evaluate --mode all --max-model-calls 8 --max-tool-calls 16. Results: results/benchmark/; protocol and comparisons: docs/EVALUATION.md.
